limits: Ratios are baseline/candidate; above one favors candidate. Six O3 pairs per task, four completed Debug Excel pairs and three Debug Word pairs. Shared host and substantial Debug variation; no formal confidence interval.
Restore observation timeout and shutdown wait timeout affected baseline runs. Both original guests were verified and stopped, their owned children removed, and incomplete samples excluded.

Functional acceptance is the current integrated Debug -O1 executable, with only jit.cpp/jit.hpp differing from the prior integrated executable. O3 comparisons use the frozen same-source native-batch reference.
Long elapsed Setup time includes long intervals with little process CPU consumption; functional acceptance is not a startup benchmark.
Other unrelated working tree edits were present when executables were frozen; exact source and binary hashes identify tested state.
This is a modest dispatch improvement, not a cumulative speedup or another 2x useful-work gain.
